clips.send: Send this to someone who thinks secret societies are just internet conspiracy talk - awe at hearing it from someone who says he was actually inside one.
clips.caption:
In 1969, at six years old, he was brought into a secret society he calls the Brotherhood — one that trains people with real psychic ability and puts them to use.

He rose to the top ranks, completed the training, and did something almost nobody inside ever does: he walked away, the only person to ever leave the group.

The only reason he's still alive, he says, is a fail-safe set up globally before he left — if anything happened to him, everything comes out.

clips.send: Send this to someone who always says things just happen to them - a little sting of recognition, then curiosity about the levels above it.
clips.caption:
There are four levels of consciousness, and almost everyone lives on the first without realizing it.

Level one is "to me" — the victim level. The water spills and it's always happening TO you, everyone's against you, nothing is ever your fault. Level two is "by me" — you take action. Level three is "through me" — there was a reason for it. The rare fourth is "as me," where you stop separating yourself from what's happening.

Most people never leave level one in their entire life.
